headline: Best Friends and a $15 Concert: An N.Y.C. Rite of Passage
context: With Music Hall of Williamsburg ending its run this year, a cartoonist and recent arrival to the city recalls the blissfully buzzed shows she saw there and elsewhere for the price of a matcha.
